description: Joe received his Master’s degree from UCLA and his B.A. From California State University, Northridge. Joe was born into a large family of 9 brothers and sisters and knows what it’s like for a family to work hard to survive. Three of Joe’s siblings were born with special needs. His little brother Benjamin contracted Leukemia, a blood cancer, at age 4, while his older sister Gina was born with neurological brain damage and his older brother Tony without the ability to hear or talk. Hence, from childhood on, Joe learned the meaning of the word struggle but also the meaning of the words: love, help and compassion.
